verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a personal AI agent, since comparable agents can plausibly be run on your own infrastructure, so the axis applies. Instinct's evidence describes only a vendor-run, invite-only service (app.instinct.com settings and workspace, Mac OS and mobile apps). A sitemap with a single homepage URL shows no docs, developer pages, or deployable artifacts, and nothing indicates the core product can be self-hosted.
